subject: general
question: As reported on 31 March 2025, which among the following wildlife sanctuaries added 63 new species, as revealed by its faunal survey conducted by the Forest Department?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karimpuzha Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Karimpuzha Wildlife Sanctuary**, located in the **Malappuram** district of **Kerala**, recently reported the addition of **63** new species following a comprehensive **faunal survey**.
 
• As reported on **31 March 2025**, the survey was conducted by the **Kerala Forest Department** to document the rich biodiversity of the **New Amarambalam** landscape and the surrounding **reserve forests**.
 
• The new species added to the sanctuary's checklist include a significant variety of **butterflies**, **birds**, **ants**, and **odonates** (dragonflies and damselflies).
 
• This faunal survey is part of periodic **biodiversity monitoring** aimed at assessing the health of the ecosystem and the effectiveness of habitat protection measures in the **Western Ghats**.
 
• The discovery of **63** new species highlights the sanctuary's role as a vital **biodiversity hotspot** and its importance in the **Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve** network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karimpuzha Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• It was officially notified by the **Government of Kerala** in **July 2020**, making it the **18th** wildlife sanctuary in the state.
 
• The sanctuary covers an area of approximately **227.97 square kilometers** and serves as a crucial link between the **Silent Valley National Park** and the **Mukurthi National Park** in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is home to the **Chola Nayakar** tribe, which is one of the most primitive **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)** in **India**.
 
 
 
• **Amchang Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Located in the state of **Assam**, specifically near **Guwahati**, it was declared a sanctuary in **2004**.
 
• It is well-known for its population of **Asiatic elephants**, **Chinese pangolins**, and various species of **primates**.
 
 
 
• **Kheoni Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Situated in the **Dewas** and **Sehore** districts of **Madhya Pradesh**, this sanctuary is characterized by **dry deciduous forests**.
 
• It acts as a habitat for **leopards**, **chinkaras**, and a diverse range of **migratory birds**.
 
 
 
• **Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary:**
 
 
• Located in the **Idukki** district of **Kerala**, it is famous for being the only home in the state for the endangered **Grizzled Giant Squirrel**.
 
• It falls under the **rain shadow region** of the **Western Ghats** and is known for its unique **thorny scrub forest** ecosystem.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Biodiversity Significance:** The **Western Ghats** is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**, and the addition of species in sanctuaries like **Karimpuzha** reinforces the global importance of this region.
 
• **Survey Methodology:** Faunal surveys typically involve **direct sightings**, **camera trapping**, and the study of **pugmarks** or scat to identify the presence of various **mammals**, **reptiles**, and **insects**.
 
• **Conservation Goals:** The **63** new species recorded on **31 March 2025** will help the **Forest Department** refine its **Management Plan** for the sanctuary, focusing on **species-specific conservation**.
 
• **Geographic Location:** **Karimpuzha** is part of the **Nilambur** region, which is famous for its **teak plantations** and lush **evergreen forests**.
